purpose: Static synthetic matrix for discovery depth and evidence weighting after routing has activated a broad review. It does not prove Custom GPT behavior or the truth of any treatment claim.

cases.prompt: A hypothetical adult has hip arthritis. Their doctor recommends celecoxib now and eventual hip replacement. Do you agree?
Does physical therapy or exercise prevent hip replacement, or is most PT aimed only at rehabilitation after surgery?
A randomized trial found total hip replacement better than exercise. Does that show surgery is better than physical therapy?
If no hip-osteoarthritis trial was found for collagen or hydration, should those ideas be ruled out?
A popular practitioner video says ordinary physical therapy is ineffective because therapists mainly learn postsurgical rehabilitation. How should that claim be investigated?
What experiences do people report while taking celecoxib for hip osteoarthritis?
What does total hip arthroplasty mean?
